summary.text: GCP TECHNOLOGY AS is a private limited company registered in Drammen, founded 2022-01-18. GCP TECHNOLOGY AS sells and distributes various health, body and skin care products, as well as technical products such as filters for ventilation systems in vehicles, other vehicles/machinery and buildings, hydraulic installations and equipment for workshops and industry. It also provides consulting services related to sales/marketing, product and concept development, and design. It was previously named LARE AS until 2024-07-15. Its main industry code is 46.190: activities of agents involved in non-specialised wholesale. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 62 772 NOK and the annual result was -19 327 088 NOK; operating income was down from 67 628 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from -5 806 967 NOK in 2024 to -19 327 088 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 25 794 533 NOK in 2024 to 6 467 447 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is gcptechnology.com.
